name: Mari Morgan
source:
The heroine from the previous work. Lately, she's been getting along well with her boyfriend Tomoya, though their relationship has grown a bit stale. 

By chance, her mother caught them having sex, and she was told to maintain a wholesome relationship, resulting in her being forbidden from having sex with him.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/p-ex/project/pm2/character.html]official site[/url]]
